name: Nordkirchen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, blue and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nordkirchen (a yellow castle with three towers on blue).
history: The flag is gold (yellow), blue and gold (yellow) striped in the ratio 1:3:1.

features.role: Nordkirchen arms — castle with three towers on blue
